items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The only thing that I do remember was that in the 1940s... they used to have mules for pulling floats... The Zulu parade didn’t really go to Canal Street.

ctx.x: I was talking to Royce Osborn. He’s doing a documentary on the Zulu. Do you have any insights or any feelings?
Yeah. The King, Louis Armstrong, and that they had actually gone to the White House and presented Obama with a coconut.
